title: Ending Forced Arbitration of Race Discrimination Act of 2025
latestAction: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
summary:
Ending Forced Arbitration of Race Discrimination Act of 2025 

This bill prohibits a predispute arbitration agreement or predispute joint-action waiver from being valid or enforceable with respect to a case relating to a race discrimination dispute at the election of the person alleging the discrimination.

actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
